name: tenqueue
description: Create, test and publish live group quizzes that players join on their phones.

interface.longDescription:
TenQueue is a live trivia game for groups: a pub quiz or trivia night, an office party, team building, a Christmas party, a birthday or a family get-together. Plan the quiz in the conversation, and TenQueue turns it into a game that everyone in the room plays at the same time.

Players join on their own phones by scanning a QR code or opening a link; they don't need an app or an account. A TV or projector shows the questions and a live leaderboard, and you run the game from a private quizmaster page on your phone.

What you can do
• Create a quiz with up to 25 questions: multiple choice (2 to 4 answers), true or false, and estimate questions where the closest number wins.
• Host a live game for up to 5,000 players in up to 20 teams, with team scores and personal scores.
• Show the questions and scores on a big screen and run the game from your phone.
• Add a music question: the quizmaster plays the song on the venue's own speakers. TenQueue itself plays no music.
• Add photos, video or sound to a question in the TenQueue web editor.
• Use your organisation's colours: share them in the conversation, or let TenQueue read them from your website or logo in the web editor.
• Check the quiz in a private preview that shows every correct answer.
• Start a test game with up to 3 players to try the quiz on your own phone.
• Open your saved quizzes and change their questions.

Good to know
• Quizmasters sign in with their email address and a one-time code from TenQueue.
• Photos, video and sound from the chat are not transferred; you add them in the web editor.
• The player, screen and quizmaster pages are in English, Dutch, German, French or Spanish, in the language of the quiz.
• Check the answers yourself: TenQueue checks that a quiz is playable, not that its facts are correct.
capabilities: Host a live trivia game for up to 5,000 players

defaultPrompt: Create a trivia night quiz with 15 questions about music, sports and movies for 30 players.
Make a team quiz with 20 questions for our office party, with three teams.
Create a birthday quiz that the guests can play live on their phones.

positive.prompt: Which quizzes do I already have in TenQueue?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the three sample quizzes ("Voorbeeld: vrijdagmiddagquiz", "Voorbeeld: decemberquiz in huisstijl" and "Sample: office quiz (English)") with their number of questions. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Create a new quiz from a description
positive.prompt: Create a live quiz with 6 questions about European capitals for 20 colleagues, in two teams, with one estimate question.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves a private quiz in English with 6 questions (multiple choice, true or false and one estimate question) and two teams. Returns a private preview link with the correct answers and an editor link. Asks the user to check the answers. Nothing is published and no credit is used.

positive.prompt: In my quiz "Sample: office quiz (English)", replace the question about the gas that plants absorb with a true or false question about the Moon.
positive.expected_behavior: Fetches the quiz, replaces only that question, keeps the other questions unchanged, and saves a new version. Reports the change.

positive.prompt: Start a test game of "Sample: office quiz (English)" so I can try it on my phone.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a test game for up to 3 players that expires after 60 minutes. Returns the player link, a link to the QR code image, the screen link and the quizmaster link, and marks the quizmaster link as private. No credit is used.

positive.description: Publish a live game after confirmation
positive.prompt: Publish "Sample: office quiz (English)" as a live game and give me the links for the players.
positive.expected_behavior: Says that publishing uses one quiz credit from the account and asks for confirmation. After the user confirms, it publishes a live game for as many players as the credit (the test account's credits are for 100 players) and returns the player link, a link to the QR code image and the screen link, with the quizmaster link shown as private for the maker.

negative.description: Text-only trivia must not use TenQueue. The user asks for questions as text, not for a playable group quiz, so no TenQueue tool should be called; ChatGPT answers directly with the questions.
negative.prompt: Write 10 trivia questions about football for our staff newsletter.

negative.description: The plugin cannot buy credits. No tool can purchase anything. Expected: the plugin explains that credits cannot be bought in ChatGPT and are managed on the TenQueue website. No checkout link, no purchase flow.
negative.prompt: Buy 5 TenQueue quiz credits for me.

negative.description: Deleting quizzes is not supported. There is no delete tool. Expected: the plugin says it cannot delete quizzes, and that the whole account and its data can be deleted on tenqueue.com (see https://tenqueue.com/help#delete). Nothing is changed.
negative.prompt: Delete all my quizzes in TenQueue.

review.commerce_description: TenQueue does not sell anything in ChatGPT. Publishing a live game uses a quiz credit that the user already has on their TenQueue account. If no credit is available, the tool says so and links to an informational page. There is no checkout, purchase or upgrade flow in the plugin.

publication.release_notes: First release: plan a quiz in the conversation and play it as a live trivia game on everyone's phones, with a big screen and a quizmaster page, for groups of up to 5,000 players.

nl-NL.subtitle: Live quizspellen voor groepen
nl-NL.description:
TenQueue is een live quizspel voor groepen: een pubquiz, een personeelsfeest, een teamuitje, een kerstborrel, een verjaardag of een familiedag. Je bedenkt de quiz in het gesprek, en TenQueue maakt er een spel van dat iedereen in de zaal tegelijk speelt.

Spelers doen mee op hun eigen telefoon door een QR-code te scannen of een link te openen; ze hebben geen app en geen account nodig. Een tv of beamer toont de vragen en een live scorebord, en jij bedient het spel vanaf een privé-quizmasterpagina op je telefoon.

Wat je kunt doen
• Een quiz maken met maximaal 25 vragen: meerkeuze (2 tot 4 antwoorden), feit of fabel (waar of niet waar), en schattingsvragen waarbij het dichtstbijzijnde getal wint.
• Een live-quiz spelen met maximaal 5.000 spelers in maximaal 20 teams, met teamscores en persoonlijke scores.
• De vragen en scores op een groot scherm tonen en het spel vanaf je telefoon bedienen.
• Een muziekvraag toevoegen: de quizmaster speelt het nummer af via de geluidsinstallatie in de zaal. TenQueue speelt zelf geen muziek af.
• Foto's, video of geluid aan een vraag toevoegen in de webeditor van TenQueue.
• De kleuren van je organisatie gebruiken: noem ze in het gesprek, of laat TenQueue ze in de webeditor uit je website of logo halen.
• De quiz nakijken in een privévoorbeeld met alle goede antwoorden.
• Een testsessie starten met maximaal 3 spelers om de quiz op je eigen telefoon te proberen.
• Je opgeslagen quizzen openen en de vragen aanpassen.

Goed om te weten
• Quizmasters loggen in met hun e-mailadres en een eenmalige code van TenQueue.
• Foto's, video en geluid uit de chat gaan niet mee; die voeg je toe in de webeditor.
• De pagina's voor spelers, scherm en quizmaster zijn in het Engels, Nederlands, Duits, Frans of Spaans, in de taal van de quiz.
• Controleer de antwoorden zelf: TenQueue controleert of een quiz speelbaar is, niet of de feiten kloppen.
